slug: 2026-04-19 Ministerial meeting on digital transformation, civil-service reform and unified social registry (SUNA)

facts.fact: SUNA reports that the ministers of human resources and social welfare and of digital transformation discussed the level of progress in creating the unified social registry system, meant to improve targeting of poor and vulnerable groups.

systems.owner: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Welfare

note: Only a proposed WFP feasibility study; no registry stage stated as procured, piloted or in service.

facts.fact: Sudan's Solidarity and Poverty Reduction Council approved the unified social registry, with an executive plan to launch it in Gedaref state as a pilot, the social development minister said.

systems.owner: Commission for Social Safety, Solidarity and Poverty Reduction

note: Unified social registry named only as an intended use of survey results; no stated build or service.
